typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Host as string,
		Cluster as string,
		vCenter as string,
		{IP Address} as string,
		{Connection State} as string,
		Version as string,
		Vendor as string,
		Model as string,
		{BIOS Version} as string,
		{CPU Model} as string,
		{Socket Count} as string,
		{Core Count} as string,
		{Thread Count} as string,
		{CPU MHz} as string,
		{Mem (GB)} as string,
		{CPU Power Management} as string,
		{NIC Count} as string,
		{HBA Count} as string,
		{Boot Time} as string,
		{Days Up} as string,
		{Maintenance Mode} as string,
		{Maintenance Mode User Name} as string,
		{Maintenance Mode Days} as string,
		{Datastore Count} as string,
		{VM Count} as string,
		{vMotion Enabled} as string,
		{DAS Host State} as string,
		Owner as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		VM_Count as string,
		Owner as string,
		NIC_Count as string,
		Maintenance_Mode_User_Name as string,
		Datastore_Count as string,
		CPU_Power_Management as string,
		Connection_State as string,
		Mem__GB_ as string,
		IP_Address as string,
		Days_Up as string,
		Maintenance_Mode as string,
		CPU_Model as string,
		Version as string,
		Boot_Time as string,
		CPU_MHz as string,
		vCenter as string,
		vMotion_Enabled as string,
		importdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Cluster as string,
		Host as string,
		Vendor as string,
		Socket_Count as string,
		Core_Count as string,
		Thread_Count as string,
		DAS_Host_State as string,
		HBA_Count as string,
		Maintenance_Mode_Days as string,
		Model as string,
		BIOS_Version as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		VM_Count = {VM Count},
		Owner,
		NIC_Count = {NIC Count},
		Maintenance_Mode_User_Name = {Maintenance Mode User Name},
		Datastore_Count = {Datastore Count},
		CPU_Power_Management = {CPU Power Management},
		Connection_State = {Connection State},
		Mem__GB_ = {Mem (GB)},
		IP_Address = {IP Address},
		Days_Up = {Days Up},
		Maintenance_Mode = {Maintenance Mode},
		CPU_Model = {CPU Model},
		Version,
		Boot_Time = {Boot Time},
		CPU_MHz = {CPU MHz},
		vCenter,
		vMotion_Enabled = {vMotion Enabled},
		importdate = ImportDate,
		Cluster,
		Host,
		Vendor,
		Socket_Count = {Socket Count},
		Core_Count = {Core Count},
		Thread_Count = {Thread Count},
		DAS_Host_State = {DAS Host State},
		HBA_Count = {HBA Count},
		Maintenance_Mode_Days = {Maintenance Mode Days},
		Model,
		BIOS_Version = {BIOS Version}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
